**Bakery Assistant - Culinary Support Center **

**Keith Kornelis** 

Culinary Support Center-Bakery | [keith_kornelis@byu.edu](mailto:keith_kornelis@byu.edu)

:::

Hello, I am the Assistant Pastry Chef at The Culinary Support Center Bakery at Brigham Young University. I worked with Diego Chuquimia in Spring and Summer 2022. He was a very eager and enthusiastic worker. He was willing to do anything that we asked him to work on. Diego was very concerned about making sure he worked all of the hours that were available to him because he is a very responsible person and he supported himself as a student here. Diego also has a very positive personality and is always happy and smiling while he is working. He always did his best work as quickly as possible to get everything done. He came in early and sometimes stayed very late helping anyone he could. He learned well and became a trusted associate with everyone at the CSC. I will miss seeing Diego at work, and hope he finds a good job with friendly people wherever life takes him. Thanks for considering him to work for you.
